that is clean and only behind

Agora's call

every 30 s: are you there?
every 5 min: here is my picture
any time: broadcasts, calls, answers

span.p:
The agent on terra
whose inbox changed

div.style: color: rgb(26, 32, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
If both Macs changed one branch,
the push that went first stands,
and Agora calls the other agent
to bring its work in on top.
Agora never rebases or pushes.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 85, 104) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Every 15 minutes each Agora
fetches anyway, so a lost
signal costs only time.
